name: Adani The Marq
summary: The project exists. Its developer (Adani Realty, via Adani M2K Realtors LLP), its location (Sector 102A, Dwarka Expressway), its RERA number (GGM/1042/774/2026/14), its 2 towers of G+46 floors, its ~5-acre site and its ₹3.99 Cr starting price are confirmed. Unit counts differ (350 ours and some brokers vs 368 per RERA Tracker). We publish no possession date, though the RERA date is 31 Dec 2031, and no configurations, though 3/4 BHK of ~2,300-3,295 sq ft are widely listed. Sources quote ₹17,500/sq ft against our ₹17,000.
